name: Amorolfine

overview.mechanism: Topical antifungal; visible nail improvement, clinical cure and negative mycology are distinct outcomes [[AMOR-ONYCHO]].
uses: Onychomycosis studied using 5% lacquer; this evidence does not concern skin cream [[AMOR-ONYCHO]].

evidence.title: Clinical evidence and limitations
evidence.intro: Study regimens are descriptions of research, not prescribing recommendations.

rows.design: Double-blind placebo-controlled trial; 111 eligible primary-care participants; six-month endpoint.
rows.intervention: Amorolfine 5% lacquer, topical miconazole or placebo.
rows.findings: No participant receiving either active treatment achieved complete cure, versus two receiving placebo. Amorolfine did not improve clinical cure, symptom burden or quality of life; mycological cure and clinical improvement favored placebo.
rows.limitations: Small sample and six-month assessment; applies to studied monotherapy in mild/moderately severe disease, not every duration or add-on regimen.

sources.citation: How effective is topical miconazole or amorolfine for mild to moderately severe onychomycosis in primary care: the Onycho Trial - a randomised double-blind placebo-controlled trial. PubMed PMID: 38702077.

draft_notes: Source-linked descriptive findings and safety information only. Current local product information, contraindications, formulation-specific dosing and renal schedules require verification.

revision_log.change: Added source-verified descriptive monograph, clinical evidence and safety limitations without unsupported dosing or inferred dialysis regimen.
revision_log.approved_by: W. G. M. Rivero, MD (delegated source-verification workflow; executed by Codex, 2026-11-25)

common: No significant between-group difference in reported adverse reactions was detected in Onycho; this small trial cannot exclude uncommon reactions [[AMOR-ONYCHO]].

renal: This topical nail study supplies no renal dose or dialysis data. Topical use alone does not establish safety of other exposure routes [[AMOR-ONYCHO]].
